name: Emily Beadon
title: Corporate communications consultant and media coach
bio_short: Corporate communications consultant and former journalist. Former Head of Communications at WSP and PwC. Has coached senior executives and politicians for BBC, Sky, Radio 4 and UK broadsheets. BA in Psychology, postgraduate in journalism.
bio: Emily Beadon is the owner and director of SHG Communications, a corporate communications consultancy. Prior to setting up SHG, Emily spent over 15 years' working in communications both in the UAE, the UK and New Zealand. She began her career as a journalist in NZ before going into politics as press secretary to the then NZ Minister of Education, Energy and Economic Development. After spending ten years in London both in agency and in-house she moved to Dubai where she worked for several companies including as Head of Communications for construction consultancy WSP, Head of Internal Communications for management consultant PwC, Head of Communication & Marketing for oil & gas firm McDermott and most recently as a Communications Consultant for Careem. During her career she has coached senior executives and politicians for interviews (both proactive, reactive and crisis situations) with high profile international media such as BBC news, Sky news, BBC Radio 4's Today programme and UK broadsheets such as FT, Guardian, Telegraph and Times. Emily has a Bachelor of Arts in psychology, a post graduate degree in journalism and a condensed MBA from PwC's Academy.
bio_long: Emily is the owner and director of SHG Communications, a corporate communications consultancy. Prior to setting up SHG, she spent over 15 years working in communications in the UAE, the UK and New Zealand. She began her career as a journalist in New Zealand before going into politics as press secretary to the then NZ Minister of Education, Energy and Economic Development. After spending ten years in London both in agency and in-house, she moved to Dubai where she worked for several companies including as Head of Communications for construction consultancy WSP, Head of Internal Communications for management consultant PwC, Head of Communication and Marketing for oil and gas firm McDermott, and most recently as a Communications Consultant for Careem. During her career she has coached senior executives and politicians for interviews with high-profile international media such as BBC News, Sky News, BBC Radio 4's Today programme and UK broadsheets such as the FT, Guardian, Telegraph and Times. She has prepared spokespeople for both proactive and crisis situations, and understands the different demands each places on the communicator. Emily has a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, a postgraduate degree in Journalism and a condensed MBA from PwC's Academy. Her psychology background informs her coaching approach, helping clients understand and manage the anxiety and cognitive challenges that arise in high-pressure media situations. Her experience across journalism, politics and multiple corporate sectors gives her an unusually well-rounded perspective on communications, and her training is valued for its practicality and directness.
